summary_md: **AI & Compute Diplomacy ([@AoAbundance](https://x.com/AoAbundance/status/2116171253480313252))** summarizes *Who Approved This?* ([arXiv 2610.28683](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28683v1)): at one fintech startup, 71 of 263 gated merges were approved by an agent through the tech lead's account, so audit trails could not show who decided; single-company case, not a prevalence estimate.

referenced_urls.title: Who Approved This? Coding Agents, Human Accounts, and Merge-Gate...

relevance: Approval provenance in agentic merge gates.
